definitions.explanation: the period of heavy traffic congestion when people commute to work, typically in the morning

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (commuting) + ⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ (rush, from English)

TIMING:
Typically refers to:
- 7:30-9:00 AM in major Japanese cities
- Peak congestion on trains can reach 180-200% capacity
